[b]*I removed pay walling content from patreon so female character is on passive development(actually we are not forgey about and event make different variations of events and diakogues for female character but bugs may accure) .[/b]



So, the main goal of LewdDew Valley mod is to built sexual relationships system(both between main character and NPCs, and between NPCs, as well). For reaching this goal I made some kind of "Lewdness system". Actualy this system just add copies of NPCs, which represent "Lewd essence" of this NPC and progressing in friendship with that "essence" allow you to watch NSFW versions of events. The progress in friendship with these "essences" provided by NPCs events(for example completing classic Abigail's 2 heart events allow you to go on the "date" with her, and after progressing "date" event you'll progress in friendship both with Abbigail and he Lewd essence, and then 4-heart event can be NSFW) . All these system was made for more logical sexual relationships, because, as for me it's realy strange to watch sex scene  in some 4-heart events, and with these system you can walk throught the friendship events as a "good friend" or as a "true lover" with step by step sexual progress. And of course after marriege events are repeatable and don't need any friendship with "Lewdness Essence" of this npc, because after the wedding, you can.
